content: fvp (main fb4e11e, 2026-10-25): Windows creates its own D3D11 device on FlutterView::GetGraphicsAdapter, SetMultithreadProtected, renders into private RT and CopyResource+Flush into a shared-handle texture inside the GpuSurfaceTexture callback; ReleaseRT waits for UnregisterTexture callback before deleting the player (deterministic release). macOS Metal: private MTLTexture blitted into IOSurface CVPixelBuffer in copyPixelBuffer (TODO pool). Linux renders in FlTextureGL populate on Flutter's GL context, disables Impeller scissor. Texture fixed to video size (or max clamp), recreated with new id on change. Default decoders prefer HW: windows MFT:d3d=11,D3D11,DXVA,CUDA; macos VT; linux VAAPI,CUDA,VDPAU then FFmpeg.
